newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: F&N unit sees profit doubling from S$13.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: F&N unit sees profit doubling from S$13.9 mln.

text.p: Fraser & Neave's soft drink unit F&N Coca-Cola sees its pre-tax profit doubling in the fiscal year ending September 30, 1997 from Singapore $13.909 million, a company official said on Tuesday.

Last year's profit before interest and tax (PBIT) was Singapore $27.965 million. This was before discounting a S$14.056 million related to the regional office costs, he said. On Monday, its president and chief operating officer, Burke McKinney told analysts and reporters he was confident of doubling profits despite the profit slip in the first half ended March 31, 1997.
The division's PBIT for the first half slipped to S$16.56 million compared to S$22.26 million for the same period last year.
